notes: No investment-gold VAT exemption: Skatteetaten states investment-gold turnover is taxable, sales to private persons follow ordinary rules; jewellery 25%. Legal-tender gold coins exempt (VAT Act s.3-6). Duty 0: Tolletaten tariff (ed. from 1 Jan 2019, toll.no) shows rate 0 on all Ch. 71 gold (71.08) and silver (71.06) lines. No primary dealer bar list opened, premiums null.

sources.name: Skatteetaten - VAT rates for purchase and sale of gold
sources.what: Rate table: 'Gold jewellery and other gold objects 25%'; gold sold by weight and fineness to businesses/public enterprises is under reverse charge (buyer calculates VAT).

sources.name: Skatteetaten - VAT Handbook M-11-1.4, domestic turnover of gold
sources.what: States turnover of investment gold in Norway is taxable, unlike most of Europe, and sales to private persons remain taxable under the ordinary rules - bullion bars take 25% VAT; gold coins that are legal tender are excluded (VAT Act s.3-6).

sources.name: Tolletaten (Norwegian Customs) - Customs tariff, chapter 71
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: tariff lines 71.08 (gold) and 71.06 (silver) all carry duty rate 0 (tollfri)
sources.quote: 71.08 Gull (herunder platinert gull), ubearbeidd eller som halvfabrikater eller i pulverform
